[[File:Nippett.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Nippet/Legends|Nippet]] as a wokling]]
A '''wokling''' was a baby or infant [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]]. They were fawned over by their parents and were described as adorable by most people who met them. Woklings would become Ewoks in a ceremony known as "[[Festival of Hoods|The Festival of Hoods]]."

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The term "wokling" is used somewhat inconsistently. Sometimes it refers to only the youngest Ewoks, those who have not yet [[Festival of Hoods|received their hoods]]. Other times, it is applied to Ewok children of any age. Also, some sources capitalize the term, while others do not.
